title: Catholic upbringing and church music
summary: Both were raised Catholic; talk about hymns.

blocks.x: Come on. I was going to ask a minute ago about that you were raised in the Catholic Church. I know you said you're nuns. Yeah, I am. I think your sister was a nun.
We're both Catholic. We're both Catholic. I wonder about some of those songs.
Did they ever sing those much? I was raised in the Methodist Church when I was a boy, like that, Just the Friend We Have in Jesus.
I never played that in the Catholic Church. I don't know.
My mother was Catholic and that was one of her.
